paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得收拾书桌时被清洁方面的担忧打断，却不清楚当天的实际要求；另一段记忆涉及工作流程。他可以分别保留已记得的中断与未知背景，不把相似词语当作同一种需要。例子不要求查看桌面、回想接触细节或决定哪次清洁足够，也不以是否改变卫生作为理解读法的检验。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a cleaning concern interrupting desk work without remembering the practical requirements that day; another recollection involves a workplace procedure. The interruption and unknown context can remain separate. Similar wording establishes no shared need. The scene requires no surface inspection, reconstruction of contact details, decision that cleaning was sufficient or change in hygiene to demonstrate understanding.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得清洁方面的担忧打断了事情，有些背景不清楚或想保留；现在想询问怎样谈这个困难。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不检验物品、不替人决定清洁够不够，也不要求先停止或增加动作才愿意听；需要了解的实际要求可以留待合适的专业谈话。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a remembered interruption from a cleaning concern, leaves context unclear or private and asks how to discuss the difficulty. Read only the fictional card if preferred. A listener inspects no object, decides no amount of cleaning and requires no stopping or adding an action before listening. Practical requirements can remain a question for an appropriate professional conversation.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是Y-BOCS、OCI、囤积量表、诊断或治疗任务。20条仍保留五组各四条的六类记录；计数算描述，不算动作、想法、分钟或物品，未计分不补零。五个可重叠的主题不是强迫症亚型；囤积障碍作为独立状况说明。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；任何组合不判定意图、危险、卫生需要或财物处置，不推迟合适评估或改变已有专业指示。五篇全文与支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题和入口，不含选择、计数或私人内容。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not Y-BOCS, OCI, a hoarding scale, diagnosis or treatment tasks. Twenty descriptions retain five six-category records of four. Counts concern descriptions, not actions, thoughts, minutes or possessions; unscored is not zero. Five overlapping topics are not OCD subtypes; hoarding disorder is described as a separate condition. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence. No pattern determines intent, danger, hygiene needs or property decisions. Do not use it to postpone appropriate assessment or alter existing professional instructions. All five guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without selections, counts or private content.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得收到一条答复后仍想再问，但不清楚原答复是否完整；另一次查看则涉及他必须遵守的程序。两段都可用普通词语描述，不能由同一类别推出请求多余、程序该删或事情安全。例子不要求重开记录、请别人再确认或测试少查看一次会怎样。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting to ask again after a reply but cannot recall whether the reply was complete; another check involved a required procedure. Ordinary words can describe both without a shared category proving a request unnecessary, a procedure removable or a situation safe. The scene assigns no reopening of records, further confirmation from someone else or test of checking one fewer time.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“记得的一次耽搁”“尚不知道的信息”和“愿意讨论的困难”，无需写出消息或程序内容。听者可以询问对方想了解什么，不替具体事情作保证，不数请求次数，也不把提问一概视为强迫行为。卡片只供阅读，不作为反复取得确定的固定问答。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a remembered delay, missing information and a difficulty the reader wants to discuss without message or procedure details. A listener can ask what the person wants to understand, without assurances about the situation, counting requests or treating every question as a compulsion. The card is optional reading rather than a fixed exchange to repeat until certainty arrives.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次调整排列同时涉及取用方便，另一次则只记得“不太对”，无法解释。两段不必归为相同原因，也不必比较哪种理由更正当。例子不改变物品位置、不制造不一致、不要求忍住或重复动作；尚不清楚的用途与感受可以并列保留。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls adjusting an arrangement partly for easier access and, on another occasion, only a feeling that it was not quite right. Neither a shared cause nor a ranking of legitimate reasons is required. The scene changes no objects, creates no mismatch and asks for neither resisting nor repeating an action. Unknown practical purposes and remembered feelings can remain side by side.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“有时调整或重复让我难以转向别的事；我还不知道怎样解释；部分细节想保留。”可以只读。听者不评价整齐程度或审美，不要求展示仪式、故意弄乱或接受挑战；可以讨论想怎样开始专业咨询，而不先接受完美主义或某种亚型标签。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names difficulty moving on around arranging or repeating, leaves the explanation open and keeps some details private. The card need not be spoken aloud. A listener rates neither tidiness nor taste and requires no ritual demonstration, deliberate disorder or challenge. Discussion can concern how to begin a professional conversation without first adopting a perfectionism or subtype label.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者只记得自己因一个不想要的想法的含义而难受，不愿说明内容，也不清楚当时回应的先后。短记录可以保留这些未知，不靠更详细的叙述判定品格、意图或安全。例子不补写想法内容，不要求引出画面、证明与价值观相反或反复寻找安心解释。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader remembers distress about the meaning of an unwanted thought, keeps its content private and cannot recall the sequence of responses. A short record can retain these unknowns without using a fuller account to judge character, intent or safety. The scene supplies no thought content and requires no recreated image, proof of conflict with values or repeated search for a reassuring interpretation.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“这件事的含义让我难受；我现在不想讲内容；想先了解专业谈话如何进行。”无需照着说。听者不追问画面、不判断道德身份，也不把卡片当作没有危险的证明。询问保密范围或怎样开始可以独立进行；实际安全担忧仍应按已有支持说明处理，不等待类别或交流卡给出裁决。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names distress about meaning, keeps content private and asks how a professional conversation works. No script needs to be spoken. A listener requests no image details, assigns no moral identity and treats no card as proof of safety. Questions about confidentiality or how to begin can stand alone. An actual safety concern remains subject to the existing support guidance without waiting for a category or card to supply a verdict.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得临时存放物品让一处空间更难使用，也记得一些决定涉及所有权与可用资源，却不想解释家庭背景。相同描述可以容纳多种考虑，不从犹豫判断物品价值、谁有权处理或是否属于疾病。例子不要求挑选物品、拍照、估计体积或进行一次丢弃。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls temporary storage making a space harder to use and decisions involving ownership and available resources, while keeping household context private. Similar descriptions can contain several considerations without hesitation establishing value, authority over property or a disorder. The scene requires no selected possession, photograph, volume estimate or act of disposal.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“物品决定或空间使用让我遇到困难；有些实际条件我想保留；想先问支持怎样开始。”可以只读。听者不要求清单或照片，不按数量评价人，也不代替所有者决定保留或移除。谈话不授予清理权限，现有实际危险也不等待问卷完成或房间评级才处理。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names difficulty with belongings or space, keeps some practical circumstances private and asks how support can begin. Read without a personal account. A listener requests no list or photograph, rates no person by quantities and makes no keeping or removal decision for an owner. Conversation grants no clear-out permission, and an existing practical hazard need not wait for completion or a room rating.
